title: Win Screen, Lose Screen
goal: Every game needs a way to end.
mascot_lines: Every game needs a clear way to win and a clear way to lose.
Winning means you reached the goal — like grabbing the flag.
Losing means the rules said you stopped — like running out of lives.
When the rules are fair, both winning AND losing feel good.

tier2.rephrase: Match each game ending to the screen it shows.

tier3.nudge: Reaching the flag = win. Out of hearts = lose. Out of time = lose.
